title: Clean up URLs.
description:
Add ui/urls.h to define some URLs on various of our websites.  Use the
GitLab URL for the wiki.  Add a macro to generate wiki URLs.

Update wiki URLs in comments etc.

Use the #defined URL for the docs page in
WelcomePage::on_helpLabel_clicked; that removes the last user of
topic_online_url(), so get rid of it and swallow it up into
topic_action_url().

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 8be20576c1fde45bf4f624a16a29c20224bfa5d0 succeeds

added 1 commit
  • e013c5ec - Clean up URLs.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/469/diffs?diff_id=115910046&start_sha=8be20576c1fde45bf4f624a16a29c20224bfa5d0)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for e013c5ec7f175f4e12f20f201d639e64609960de succeeds

commits_data.title: Clean up URLs.
commits_data.message:
Clean up URLs.

Add ui/urls.h to define some URLs on various of our websites.  Use the
GitLab URL for the wiki.  Add a macro to generate wiki URLs.

Update wiki URLs in comments etc.

Use the #defined URL for the docs page in
WelcomePage::on_helpLabel_clicked; that removes the last user of
topic_online_url(), so get rid of it and swallow it up into
topic_action_url().
